content_sections.heading: IIT Bombay Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online on or before 31-12-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bombay to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026 is 31st December 2026. It is advisable to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: IIT Bombay is recruiting for the posts of Assistant Professor Grade I, Assistant Professor Grade II, Associate Professor, and Professor. These positions are in various academic disciplines.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for all posts is a Ph.D. with first-class or equivalent in the preceding degree and an excellent academic record throughout. Specific experience requirements vary by post.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, as per the provided data, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. How will candidates be selected for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process typically involves an online application, followed by shortlisting of eligible candidates, and then an interview. The exact weightage of each stage may vary.

faq.question: Q6. Where can I find the official notification for IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section on this page. It is highly recommended to read it thoroughly before applying.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: All applications for the IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026 must be submitted online through the official website or the direct application link provided.

faq.question: Q8. Does IIT Bombay offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age relaxation details. Candidates belonging to reserved categories are advised to check the official notification for any applicable age relaxations.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for all the advertised posts at IIT Bombay is Full Time, indicating a permanent or long-term employment opportunity.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply offline for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for the IIT Bombay Recruitment 2026 is strictly online. Offline applications will not be considered.
